clips.title: The story
paras: Barithras Moonshade sends you south from Auberdine to speak with Onu. Your findings in Cliffspring Falls have drawn the attention of one of Darkshore's oldest guardians.

Barithras Moonshade sees more than strange fungi in the samples you brought back to Auberdine. The caves beneath Cliffspring Falls are tainted, and word of them reaches Onu, an Ancient of Lore in the Grove of the Ancients south of town. The corruption in Darkshore's waterways may reach beyond anything a naturalist can explain. Onu wants counsel, and even an Ancient's patient nature cannot hide the weight of that summons.

The road south from Auberdine turns inland, away from the coastal ruins and toward the mountain slopes. The Grove of the Ancients shelters an old refuge of nature, set apart from the decay along the shore. Onu waits among stone barrows and kindred spirits, ready to guide allies toward the blights stirring at the edge of the wilderness.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Onu, an Ancient of Lore at the Grove of the Ancients, knows of your journey to Cliffwater Falls and wishes to speak with you. The grove lies to the south, nestled near the mountains.
The Ancients are patient and wise, friend. But if Onu seeks your counsel concerning what you saw in the falls, then I fear it is urgent.

clips.title: Completion
paras: We have matters...to discuss. You and I.
